text:
Maya (CEO): follow-up from today: a few clarifications on pipeline, GTM focus, and partner next steps.
Liam (Sales): quick Q - are we changing the demo success metric? a couple of reps asked if PDs should mark demos as successful only after a POC sign-off.
Maya (CEO): no change to definition for now. demo success = buyer completes product walkthrough + agrees to next step (POC or technical deep dive). we can refine after pilot.
Aria (GTM): heads up: partners asked about co-marketing spend. are we committing to MDF for strategic partners?
Noor (RevOps): MDF budget proposal is in finance review. likely split: 60% strategic MDF, 30% regional co-op, 10% experimental. awaiting final sign-off.
Sofia (Product): product note: we will provide a limited API key for demos that surfaces token usage in UI so partners can show cost/latency.
Liam (Sales): will this key require onboarding? partners want a frictionless click-to-demo.
Sofia (Product): demo keys will be self-service in partner portal for approved partners. will surface expiration and usage caps.
Aria (GTM): request: can we ship a short "partner onboarding checklist"? partners leave if setup is painful.
Noor (RevOps): im compiling a 5-step checklist: 1) sign NDA, 2) register partner org, 3) request demo tenant, 4) complete enablement module, 5) run sample demo. will share.
DevBot: Partner portal build 0.9 deployed to staging at 1866012600.
Maya (CEO): great. last ask: leadership wants visibility into partner pipeline health weekly. can RevOps provide a one-page dashboard?
Noor (RevOps): yes  building a dashboard with: active partner opps, avg days in stage, demo conversion rate, pipeline by partner tier. ETA Fri.
Liam (Sales): ack. can we include a flag for "needs co-demo" so we surface joint outreach needs?
Noor (RevOps): will add a co-demo boolean field.
Maya (CEO): ok folks, please drop any other follow-ups here and i'll consolidate into the all-hands actions doc.
Aria (GTM): dropping draft playbook link in #product-docs in 10m. feedback welcome. :eyes:
